shuttle_services.name: Free Port Shuttle (Navette Portuaire Gratuite)
shuttle_services.route: Operates from ship berths at Léon Gourret (follow the green painted line on the ground) to Place de la Joliette / Les Terrasses du Port shopping center (9 Quai du Lazaret, near Five Guys).

pricing.notes: Completely free of charge on active cruise call days.

shuttle_services.walking_to_stop_minutes: 5 – 14 minutes along marked green line depending on berth
shuttle_services.source: Grand Port Maritime de Marseille Public Notice

shuttle_services.name: Cruise Line Motorcoach Shuttle
shuttle_services.operator: Individual Cruise Lines (MSC, Costa, Royal Caribbean, etc.)
shuttle_services.route: Direct non-stop transfer from ship gangway to the Vieux-Port (Old Port).

metro_stations.name: Joliette Metro Station
metro_stations.location: Short walk from port shuttle drop-off at Place de la Joliette
metro_stations.connectivity: Direct two-stop connection to Marseille Saint-Charles central railway station.

tramways.description: Step-free, accessible light rail connection operating through central Marseille.

taxi_services.regulatory_status: Queuing ranks stationed directly outside MPCT terminals.

transit_options.route: Airport Shuttle to Marseille Saint-Charles station (every 15-20 min) -> Metro Line 2 to Joliette
